key: It wasn't that long ago that this was just another quiet residential ward--
en: It wasn't that long ago that this was just another quiet residential ward--
ja: ついこの間まで、ここはただの静かな住宅地区だったのに――

key: But you know that entire wooded area?
en: But you know that entire wooded area?
ja: でも、あの一帯の森、知ってる?

key: "The Jungle," we started calling it--
en: "The Jungle," we started calling it--
ja: みんな「ジャングル」って呼ぶようになったんだけど――

key: It only recently became one.
en: It only recently became one.
ja: あんな風になったのは、つい最近のことなんだ。

key: Rhodochrine Park was just a peaceful city garden before it devoured all of our worlds...
en: Rhodochrine Park was just a peaceful city garden before it devoured all of our worlds...
ja: ロドクライン公園は、あたし達の世界をまるごと飲み込む前は、ただの平和な市民公園だったのよ……

key: I wanna get back to my family in Peridot, but man, heading through with all the Pokémon swarming Jasper...
en: I wanna get back to my family in Peridot, but man, heading through with all the Pokémon swarming Jasper...
ja: ペリドットの家族のところに戻りたいけど、ジャスパーでポケモンがうじゃうじゃ群がってるところを抜けるのはなぁ……

key: I dunno.
en: I dunno.
ja: どうしたもんかな。

key: Hey, did you hear?
en: Hey, did you hear?
ja: ねえ、聞いた?

key: Deep in the desert, there's a tower that only appears to certain people!
en: Deep in the desert, there's a tower that only appears to certain people!
ja: 砂漠の奥に、特定の人にしか見えない塔があるんだって!

key: Isn't that cool?!
en: Isn't that cool?!
ja: すごくない?!

key: I wonder what determines who can see it...
en: I wonder what determines who can see it...
ja: 誰が見えるかって、何で決まるんだろう……

key: Maybe it depends on how the sands shift?!
en: Maybe it depends on how the sands shift?!
ja: もしかして、砂の動き方で決まったりして?!

key: Man...
en: Man...
ja: はぁ……

key: It's like...
en: It's like...
ja: なんつーか……

key: Cutting through trees...
en: Cutting through trees...
ja: 木を切ったり……

key: Smashing through rocks...
en: Smashing through rocks...
ja: 岩を砕いたり……

key: Surfing over water...
en: Surfing over water...
ja: 水の上を波乗りしたり……

key: It's all a drag, isn't it?
en: It's all a drag, isn't it?
ja: みんな面倒くさいよな?

key: Just one big pain...
en: Just one big pain...
ja: ほんと、めんどいだけ……

key: I don't wanna deal with any of that...
en: I don't wanna deal with any of that...
ja: そういうの、一切やりたくないんだよ……

key: So I don't.
en: So I don't.
ja: だからやらない。

key: You don't have to either, you know?
en: You don't have to either, you know?
ja: あんたもやらなくていいんだぜ?

key: Next time someone asks you for a password, you could tell them "easyhms"...
en: Next time someone asks you for a password, you could tell them "easyhms"...
ja: 今度誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら、「easyhms」って答えるといいぜ……

key: Like, it's still a pain to have to wait until someone asks...
en: Like, it's still a pain to have to wait until someone asks...
ja: まあ、聞かれるまで待つのもめんどいけどよ……

key: But then you don't have to bother teaching your Pokémon field moves.
en: But then you don't have to bother teaching your Pokémon field moves.
ja: でもそうすりゃ、ポケモンにフィールド技を覚えさせる手間が省けるんだ。

key: You can just, like, not bother...
en: You can just, like, not bother...
ja: ただ、めんどくさがらずに済むってわけ……

key: Yeah?
en: Yeah?
ja: だろ?
